claims.statement: Orion Metrics Cloud provides workflow analytics for distributed field-service teams.
The company reported $24.6m of FY2025 revenue and $27.8m of contracted ARR at year-end.
Enterprise customers represented 68% of year-end ARR.
Management described the product as mission-critical for dispatch, utilization and compliance reporting.
Management forecast more than 35% ARR growth for FY2026.
The proposed financing is a primary preferred round intended to fund product, sales and onboarding capacity.
The ARR ledger records $29.4m of ARR at June 30, 2026.
New ARR added in H1 2026 was $5.8m.
Churned ARR in H1 2026 was $1.9m.
Expansion ARR in H1 2026 was $3.1m.
The ten largest customer groups account for 31% of ARR.
No single customer group accounts for more than 6.4% of ARR.
Annual subscriptions account for 84% of ARR and multi-year subscriptions for 38% of ARR.
Implementation services are excluded from ARR and represented 9% of H1 revenue.
Independent cohort reconstruction measured gross revenue retention at 91%.
Independent cohort reconstruction measured net revenue retention at 112%, below management’s 118% presentation.
The difference in net retention arises from migration credits and customer reactivations classified as expansion by management.
Customers live for more than two years show 116% net retention.
Customers onboarded in the last twelve months show 103% net retention.
Median time to production increased from 46 to 63 days during H1 2026.
Three churned customers cited implementation delay as a primary reason.
The retention analysis reconciles to the subscription ledger within 0.3% of ARR.
Qualified pipeline for the next two quarters is $18.2m of potential ARR.
Pipeline coverage is 2.6 times the company’s new-ARR target.
Twenty-nine percent of qualified pipeline lacks a verified implementation start window.
Average sales cycle for enterprise opportunities is 142 days.
Two channel partners account for 22% of weighted pipeline.
Renewal opportunity records for two 2024 cohorts are incomplete in the CRM export.
The security diligence report found no critical unresolved vulnerability.
SOC 2 Type II coverage includes the core application and production infrastructure.
Two medium-severity access-control findings have agreed remediation dates before year-end.
The operating plan models FY2027 ARR of $45.2m under the current hiring sequence.
The operating plan models gross margin rising from 76% to 80% as hosting and support scale.
The operating plan implies a 16-month cash runway after a $28m primary financing.
The operating plan’s base case has a 1.5 times burn multiple for FY2027.
The operating plan assumes onboarding headcount increases before enterprise bookings accelerate.
The firm adopted 112% net retention as the underwriting basis.
The firm approved a maximum $28m primary commitment in two milestone-linked tranches.
The first tranche is conditioned on an onboarding-capacity plan owned by the chief operating officer.
The second tranche requires gross retention of at least 90% and time to production below 55 days.
The firm directed monthly reporting of cohort retention, implementation backlog, burn multiple and runway.
The investment committee recorded dissent that pipeline quality did not yet justify the full second tranche.

positions.proposition: The admitted ARR base is $29.4m and excludes implementation services.
Underwriting uses 112% NRR and 91% GRR, not management’s 118% presentation.
Pipeline is sufficient in volume but partially uncovered on implementation readiness.
A 1.5x burn multiple is achievable only if hiring precedes bookings in the modeled sequence.
The proposed financing creates sixteen months of base-case runway.
Implementation capacity is the principal operating constraint on growth.
Security posture supports enterprise growth subject to dated remediation.
A two-tranche $28m primary commitment is the preferred structure.
New cohorts are weaker than mature cohorts and require monthly monitoring.
Channel concentration is material but not currently a gating risk.
Time to production must fall below 55 days before the second tranche.
Pipeline-quality dissent remains attached to the second tranche.
